preconditions.description: Number of cards is between 1 and 100.
Required total power is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= 1000 for pi, _, _ in cards)
preconditions.description: Power of each card is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= 100000 for _, ci, _ in cards)
preconditions.description: Magic number of each card is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= li <= n for _, _, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Level of each card is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a positive integer representing the minimum level.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(pi <= return_value for pi, _, _ in cards)
postconditions.description: If a valid level is found, all card levels are within the character's level.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or sum(pi for pi, _, _ in cards if pi <= return_value) >= k
postconditions.description: If a valid level is found, the total power of the selected cards is at least k.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or not any(is_prime(ci + cj) for i, (pi, ci, li) in enumerate(cards) for j, (pj, cj, lj) in enumerate(cards) if i != j and pi <= return_value and pj <= return_value)
postconditions.description: If a valid level is found, no two selected cards have a prime sum of magic numbers.
